title: Harbor Arts Festival — Volunteer page · E-mail · To: volunteer@harborarts.org · From: Nora Bell · Volunteer schedule — Saturday, June 7 (children's art tent)
L: We are looking for volunteers to help at this year's festival, June 6–8.
Volunteers work one four-hour shift and receive a free festival T-shirt and a ticket to the closing concert.
Shifts are available at the information desk, the ticket gate and the children's art tent.
Volunteers under 18 must work with an adult volunteer.
To sign up, e-mail volunteer@harborarts.org with your preferred day and area.
(2) E-mail · To: volunteer@harborarts.org · From: Nora Bell
Hello, I would like to volunteer at the festival on Saturday, June 7.
I am a primary school teacher, so I would be happy to help in the children's art tent.
My 16-year-old son would also like to volunteer.
Could we work the same shift?
